name: forum: a collection of count tables split by condition
description: From help.galaxyproject.org (2026, 'Select collection files for DESeq2'): DESeq2 takes one collection per factor level, and the user has one collection of all samples. The history holds a list of four count tables, ctrl_1, ctrl_2, treat_1, treat_2. Filtering with Galaxy's tools (Filter collection, Apply rules) keeps the step in the history. Graded on the control and treated sets Galaxy holds afterwards and that tools produced them; how many intermediate collections the route leaves is not graded.
inputs: My collection "counts" has count tables for control and treated samples. For DESeq2 I need the control samples and the treated samples as two separate collections. Please split it by condition.
